title: Neil Diamond – Greatest Hits (8-Track Tape Bang Records Ampex, VTG) Web IV Music
descriptionText:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Artist: Neil Diamond
Album: Greatest Hits
Label: Bang Records / Ampex (BAM 8219)
Country: USA
Genre: Pop, Rock, Singer-Songwriter
Era: 1960s
Track Listing (Programs):
Cherry, Cherry / Oh No No / Girl, You’ll Be a Woman Soon
New Orleans / You Got to Me / Red Red Wine
Do It / Thank the Lord for the Night Time / Hanky Panky
Solitary Man / Kentucky Woman / The Boat That I Row
Condition:
Tape Cartridge: Good overall vintage condition. Cartridge has scuffs and surface wear.
Labels: Light age discoloration with minor spotting. Still clear and legible.
Slipcase: Original Bang Records/Ampex slipcase included. Shows edge wear, surface scuffing, and some paper loss (see photos).
Untested: This tape has not been play-tested. Offered as a collectible.
Please see all photos provided – they are part of the description.
Notes:
Classic Bang Records era Neil Diamond release on original 8-track format.
Features many of his early hit singles including “Cherry, Cherry,” “Girl, You’ll Be a Woman Soon,” “Red Red Wine,” and “Solitary Man.”
Great display piece for Neil Diamond fans or 8-track collectors.
